```{r}
# Load libraries
library(reticulate)
library(Seurat)
#library(sceasy)

options(Seurat.object.assay.version = 'v5')
convert_anndata_to_seurat <- function(anndata_obj, batch = FALSE) {
  anndata_obj$obs_names_make_unique()

  # Extract the data from the AnnData object
  counts <- t(as.matrix(anndata_obj$X))  # Transpose the data matrix
  var_names <- py_to_r(anndata_obj$var_names)
  obs_names <- py_to_r(anndata_obj$obs_names)
  
  # Create a Seurat object
  rownames(counts) <- var_names
  colnames(counts) <- obs_names
  seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = "ConvertedAnndata")
  
  # Add metadata if batch is TRUE
  if (batch) {
    batch_data <- py_to_r(anndata_obj$obs$batch)
    seurat_obj <- AddMetaData(object = seurat_obj, metadata = batch_data, col.name = 'batch')
  }
  
  # Filter by nFeature_RNA
  seurat_obj <- subset(seurat_obj, subset = nFeature_RNA > 2 & nFeature_RNA < 1000)

  # Filter out genes with zero counts
  counts_matrix <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, slot = "counts")
  seurat_obj <- subset(seurat_obj, features = rownames(counts_matrix)[Matrix::rowSums(counts_matrix) > 3])
  
  return(seurat_obj)
}

# Example usage:
# seurat_object <- convert_anndata_to_seurat(anndata_object)

# Save the Seurat object to an RDS file
# saveRDS(seurat_object, file = "path/to/save/seurat_object.rds")
```

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(Seurat)
library(biomaRt)

# Load the dataset
mouse <- readRDS("scrnaseq_all_inhib/mou_exonic_sce_final (1).rds")
mouse <- as.Seurat(mouse, counts = "umi", data = "umi")

# Get the counts matrix
counts_matrix <- GetAssayData(mouse, slot = "counts")

# Create Seurat object while preserving metadata
mouse_seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts_matrix, meta.data = mouse@meta.data)

# Subset specific cell types
mouse_seurat_1 <- subset(mouse_seurat, subset = cell_type %in% c("GABA_DN", "VZ_neuroblast","interneuron" , "Purkinje"))
mouse_seurat <- JoinLayers(merge(mouse_seurat_1))
# Add metadata annotations
mouse_seurat@meta.data$dataset <- mouse_seurat@meta.data$Capture.System
mouse_seurat@meta.data$timepoint <- mouse_seurat@meta.data$Stage

# Ensure rownames are unique before mapping
rownames(mouse_seurat) <- make.unique(rownames(mouse_seurat))

# Save original rownames and counts to verify mapping later
original_rownames <- rownames(mouse_seurat)
original_counts <- mouse_seurat@assays$RNA$counts
```


```{r}
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)

# Map Ensembl gene IDs to symbols
ensembl_ids <- rownames(mouse_seurat)
mapped <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Mm.eg.db,
  keys = ensembl_ids,
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  columns = c("SYMBOL")
)

# Ensure unique names and align with original
mapped <- mapped[match(ensembl_ids, mapped$ENSEMBL), ]
new_gene_names <- make.unique(mapped$SYMBOL)
rownames(mouse_seurat) <- new_gene_names
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)

# Assuming your Seurat object is named 'seurat_obj' and already clustered
Idents(VZ_i1) <- "DCN"

# Step 1: Find all positive markers for each cluster
markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  VZ_i1,
  group.by = "DCN",
  only.pos = TRUE,
  min.pct = 0.4,
  logfc.threshold = 0.4
)

# Step 2: Get top 10 markers per cluster by log2 fold-change
top_markers <- markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  top_n(n = 5, wt = avg_log2FC)

# Step 3: Plot heatmap of top markers
DoHeatmap(VZ_i1, features = top_markers$gene) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))
```
